correctness.rationale: PASS: Every independent k-subset of C_n has exactly r=n-2k cyclic 00 edges. Segment parity choices yield the upper bound min(k,r+1), and the support at positions 0,2,...,2(t-1) has explicit completions via short segments plus a length >=r+2 closing segment. Marked-vertex compositions count the concept class exactly. Concatenated independently movable zero-gap blocks realize the online threshold-product lower bound, and concept-counting gives the upper bound, proving r log2(k)+O_r(1). The analogous path bound follows from padded-endpoint parity and a block product with one terminal zero deleted. The extracted Python program checked 45 finite VC parameter cases, 32 exact online cases, 284 supporting assignment constructions and 203 threshold-block parameter cases; finite tests do not prove the infinite statements.

value.rationale: PASS: The cycle and path concept classes have identical VC dimension min(k,r+1) but fixed-defect online dimensions whose leading logarithmic coefficients differ by exactly one. Explicit constructions and matching information bounds explain the difference as a lost independently movable defect when the boundary is closed. This is a motivated structural separation across an entire natural family, rather than an arbitrary small-n computation or an unmotivated counting identity.
